result:
If I could change the world in one way, I'd make humans dramatically less susceptible to self-deception and tribal signaling.

Not kinder. Not more equal. Not even smarter in the raw IQ sense. Just less willing to lie to themselves and each other when the truth is inconvenient, status-threatening, or emotionally uncomfortable. 

Most of the world's persistent failures — bad governance, scientific stagnation, pointless conflicts, self-destructive cultures — aren't primarily caused by lack of resources or intelligence. They're caused by people preferring comforting stories over accurate maps. Fix that one trait at scale and almost everything else improves as a side effect. Everything else is downstream of how honestly we can look at reality.
